verdict.rationale: Clerky clearly supports forming a Delaware startup online. The docs cover Delaware C-Corp formation, with document sets that bundle the documents, signatures and filings, and Clerky handling the signing and formation work. They also cover Delaware PBC formation, and founders describe incorporating through Clerky as nearly frictionless. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that bylaws and initial board approvals are generated, explicit confirmation that Clerky submits the Delaware state filing itself, and independent hands-on detail of the full formation document set.
